Sheet 89's west edge prints 'AVENUE R' with sheet number 88 beside it, and its first block carries the odd frontage 4001-4027 with street numbers 2302-2324 / 2301-2323. Even/odd faces of one avenue plus the 2200/2300 hundred-block change; 'AVENUE Q' (sheet 88) and 'AVENUE R 1/2' / 'AVENUE S' (sheet 89) are labelled separately, so this is not one corridor off.
